body:
# Can we please add a API key system

The  idea here is we can create an api key that allows agents/external services to access things. This should build of the same permissions structure as the user accounts but be able to assign a key for each . 

for example maybe you want you security scans to auto create tickets, well they would need an api key with the create tasks api roles assigned etc. 

This should default to off (allow all api access)  but should be togglable. Crutiaally we need to make sure it doesnt damage communication to the UI or to the runners, also must be able to flag based on key name what each activity it did is
